entries.retiredReason: Retired by VLN-007. The measurement is real and is kept as a historical artifact, but it was measured on benchmarks/splits/visa-subset.gold.json, whose 700 assignments are ALL in train: the upstream VisA release carries no session column, so the capture group of an item is its object class, and a group larger than every quota cannot be divided into three partitions. With zero held-out images the number is not a performance figure and must not be published as one. The tracked split is now benchmarks/splits/visa-subset.v2.gold.json (suite visa-subset.v2, strategy stratified); re-run the predictions against it and record a new baseline.
